related.title: LUMI-G：不能依序號推論 NUMA 的排列成本
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付範圍解析測例、反向擁有者表、兩個有效配置及一個故意重複的配置；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障；附可執行實作：python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-002 --out ./hpc-a-002-evidence；輸出資料夾須不存在，程式提供逐筆合成證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver range-parser cases, a reverse ownership table, both valid allocations and one intentionally overlapping allocation. Include a concise rejection reason that a learner can trace to specific CPU identifiers. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system. Executable fixture: python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-002 --out ./hpc-a-002-evidence. The output directory must not exist; the program emits per-record synthetic evidence.
related.difference: 產生 mapping.csv、assignment.csv、costs.csv；要求裝置鍵唯一，每個配置必須引用存在的 NUMA 節點。
related.differenceEn: Create mapping.csv, assignment.csv and costs.csv. Enforce unique device keys and existing NUMA references, then materialize a joined row for every transfer before performing arithmetic.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每個 rank 的 CPU 集合需與其他隔離集合不相交；總需求為集合聯集的基數，不能把字串長度當處理器數；教學配置 12 個 tile 程序，每個使用 4 個不同 CPU；變更為 8 個程序。CPU 編號允許不連續，且不是 Aurora 實際綁定表；名義式 12*4 = 48 CPU identifiers；變更式 8*4 = 32 CPU identifiers。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
把裝置到 NUMA 的映射視為查表函數，再對每條等量傳輸累加教學成本；成本單位是模型權重而非量測奈秒；八條傳輸，局部成本 2、遠端成本 9；名義全為局部，變更為六條局部與二條遠端；名義式 8*2 = 16 cost units；變更式 6*2+2*9 = 30 cost units。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Isolation is a pairwise-disjointness condition. Capacity is the cardinality of the union of allowed CPU identifiers; string length, maximum CPU number and summed set sizes are different quantities. Use twelve synthetic tile processes with four distinct CPU identifiers each, then eight processes. Identifiers may have gaps. These are teaching sets, not the production Aurora binding table or a claim about enabled hardware. Nominal 12*4 = 48 CPU identifiers; changed 8*4 = 32 CPU identifiers. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Treat device-to-NUMA placement as an explicit lookup, then sum the assigned costs of equal-sized transfers. Model cost units are pedagogical weights, not measured nanoseconds or a linear performance prediction. Supply a nonidentity permutation for eight devices. Local transfers cost 2 units and remote transfers cost 9. All eight are local initially; after changing two bindings, six remain local and two become remote. Nominal 8*2 = 16 cost units; changed 6*2+2*9 = 30 cost units. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Transparent Huge Pages：稀疏觸碰的配置放大
related.titleEn: Transparent Huge Pages: allocation amplification from sparse touches
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付範圍解析測例、反向擁有者表、兩個有效配置及一個故意重複的配置；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障；附可執行實作：python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-002 --out ./hpc-a-002-evidence；輸出資料夾須不存在，程式提供逐筆合成證據。

Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system. Executable fixture: python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-002 --out ./hpc-a-002-evidence. The output directory must not exist; the program emits per-record synthetic evidence.
related.difference: 輸入頁面位移表，計算 region_id=floor(offset/2MiB)，去重後列出每區塊有用與未使用位元組。
related.differenceEn: Read page offsets, compute region identifiers with integer division and deduplicate them. Emit useful and unused bytes for each region so sparse allocation is visible before calculating a global amplification ratio.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每個 rank 的 CPU 集合需與其他隔離集合不相交；總需求為集合聯集的基數，不能把字串長度當處理器數；教學配置 12 個 tile 程序，每個使用 4 個不同 CPU；變更為 8 個程序。CPU 編號允許不連續，且不是 Aurora 實際綁定表；名義式 12*4 = 48 CPU identifiers；變更式 8*4 = 32 CPU identifiers。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

在強制成功配置 2 MiB 區塊的教學模型中，實體量為被觸碰的不同區塊數乘 2 MiB；頁面實際政策需另外觀察；每個基本頁 4 KiB，65 次各觸碰一頁；名義分散在 65 個 2 MiB 區塊，變更連續放進同一區塊；名義式 65*2 = 130 MiB；變更式 ceil(65*4/2048)*2 = 2 MiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Isolation is a pairwise-disjointness condition. Capacity is the cardinality of the union of allowed CPU identifiers; string length, maximum CPU number and summed set sizes are different quantities. Use twelve synthetic tile processes with four distinct CPU identifiers each, then eight processes. Identifiers may have gaps. These are teaching sets, not the production Aurora binding table or a claim about enabled hardware. Nominal 12*4 = 48 CPU identifiers; changed 8*4 = 32 CPU identifiers. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

In the deliberately idealized model where every touched region receives one 2 MiB allocation, footprint is distinct touched regions times 2 MiB. Real allocation policy, collapse and splitting require separate observations. Use sixty-five 4 KiB touches. Initially each lies in a different 2 MiB region; after relocation all sixty-five occupy consecutive pages in one region. Requested useful bytes remain 260 KiB. Nominal 65*2 = 130 MiB; changed ceil(65*4/2048)*2 = 2 MiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
